humans.name: Humans
humans.tagline: Every human is a question the world hasn’t answered yet.
humans.theme: Masters of bad options — they survive by making deals, adapting fast and paying the price later.
humans.summary: The most widespread people of the shattered world. Adaptable, resilient, painfully easy to use. Bearers of demonic marks, keepers of small fires in dark places.

deck.name: Refuse to Give Up
deck.trigger: Stay in the scene when you should be out — one more breath, make them hesitate, a dirty exit, or hard terms.

options.label: I — One More Breath
options.description: You steady yourself and keep moving, one last push to stay in the scene when anyone else would fold.

options.label: II — Make Them Hesitate
options.description: It’s hopeless — but you surge one last time and force the other side to hesitate.

options.label: III — Dirty Exit
options.description: You’ve been here too often. You slip out by exploiting patterns, people, chaos, and weaknesses.

options.label: IV — Hard Terms
options.description: You force structure into chaos: conditions, leverage, and a controlled de-escalation — on your terms.

deck.name: Desperate Bargain
deck.trigger: Win with no clean options — name your price, sweeten the lie, make it personal, or play the room.

options.label: I — Name Your Price
options.description: You state what you’ll give and what you demand — so the bargain has teeth.

options.label: II — Sweeten the Lie
options.description: You wrap the deal in half-truths, plausible deniability, and a story they want to believe.

options.label: III — Make It Personal
options.description: You push the one argument that hits the heart: duty, fear, love, shame, or hope.

options.label: IV — Play the Room
options.description: You turn the moment into a scene — timing, tone, audience — so the bargain becomes inevitable.

deck.name: Scraprunner Instinct
deck.trigger: Solve it with junk and nerve — quick hands, body as tool, do it quiet, or force it through.

options.label: I — Quick Hands, Quick Fix
options.description: You patch, swap, or palm the missing piece fast enough that nobody can stop you.

options.label: II — Make It Move
options.description: You use your body as the tool — balance, timing, and momentum to turn a bad setup into a working solution.

options.label: III — Do It Quiet
options.description: You improvise without drawing eyes: no noise, no obvious traces, no attention.

options.label: IV — Force It Through
options.description: You brute the solution into place — bend, pry, drag, wedge — until reality gives in.

deck.name: Hard Road Lessons
deck.trigger: Survive the ugly day — follow signs, stay alive, calm the beast, or read the sky.

options.label: I — Follow the Signs
options.description: You read the ground, the breaks, the rhythm — finding where they went and how close they are.

options.label: II — Stay Alive Anyway
options.description: Shelter, warmth, water, food — whatever the land gives, you take, without wasting time.

options.label: III — Calm the Beast
options.description: You steady a mount, silence an animal, or keep panic from turning into catastrophe.

options.label: IV — Read the Sky
options.description: You catch what’s coming before it hits — storm, cold, heat, bad visibility — and adjust in time.

halflings.name: Halflings
halflings.tagline: The hearth is not a place. It is whoever still shares the last crust.
halflings.theme: Hunted remnants of ordinary joy — fugitives who survive through kinship, hidden paths, quick hands, and the refusal to let Hell turn hunger into identity.
halflings.summary: The hearthfolk of Tyhra: nearly extinct survivors whose warmth, memory, and soul-rich blood are prized as demonic delicacies. Most live on the run; others survive in locked cellars and feast-prisons, waiting to be served.

deck.name: Hearth Ties
deck.trigger: Strangers must trust one another, or a scattered group must act as one.

options.label: I — Share the Last Crumb
options.description: You offer food, shelter, truth, or vulnerability and make cooperation safer than suspicion.

options.label: II — Fair Trade
options.description: You set terms both sides can accept and make breaking them costlier than keeping them.

options.label: III — Read the Empty Bowl
options.description: You recognize the hunger beneath anger or pride and speak to what they fear losing.

options.label: IV — Keep the Fire Together
options.description: You give everyone one task and one reason. Panic becomes a plan.

deck.name: Too Small to Keep
deck.trigger: A larger enemy, cage, crowd, or collapsing route tries to contain you.

options.label: I — Through the Gap
options.description: You fold, climb, and slip through an opening never meant to be a path.

options.label: II — Not Worth Seeing
options.description: You become part of clutter, shadow, furniture, or crowd until attention moves on.

options.label: III — Move with the Noise
options.description: You cross the dangerous space inside noise, footsteps, or another creature's distraction.

options.label: IV — Key in the Palm
options.description: A latch opens, a key changes hands, or a chain quietly loosens.

deck.name: Cellar-Born Lessons
deck.trigger: You face captivity, scarcity, guarded stores, kitchens, or hidden passages.

options.label: I — Count the Guards
options.description: You map routines, keys, blind moments, and the mistake repeated each day.

options.label: II — Know Who Takes Bribes
options.description: You identify who can be moved without alerting the whole structure.

options.label: III — Live on Less
options.description: You stretch crumbs, water, warmth, and time far beyond expectation.

options.label: IV — Keep Them Breathing
options.description: You stabilize someone with almost nothing until escape is possible.

deck.name: The Hunger Hunts
deck.trigger: Demons or their servants track, corner, or select someone for consumption.

options.label: I — Smell Them First
options.description: You notice the appetite first: changed breath, a fixed stare, sudden silence.

options.label: II — Read the Old Feasts
options.description: You recall a demon's tastes, feast rites, and the taboo that may interrupt them.

options.label: III — Spoil the Course
options.description: You spoil food, scent, blood, or preparation so the hunters hesitate.

options.label: IV — Follow the Cart Back
options.description: You read wheel ruts, kitchen waste, chains, and supply routes to find the missing.

dwarfs.name: Dwarfs
dwarfs.tagline: Stone does not kneel. Neither do we.
dwarfs.theme: Last bastions of a broken war — incorruptible, stubborn, and built to hold the line when everything else falls.
dwarfs.summary: A dying, proud people hated by the powers of Hell. Their flesh resists demonic marks; their souls do not open willingly. Guardians of old crafts, buried names, and weapons fit to wound Hell.

deck.name: Unbreakable Terms
deck.trigger: Refuse the corner — draw the line, make it costly, rally the room, or invoke the old rules.

options.label: I — Draw the Line
options.description: You set a boundary that cannot be “misunderstood” and force the other side to answer it.

options.label: II — Make It Costly
options.description: You remind them what refusal will cost. Not loudly. Clearly.

options.label: III — Rally the Room
options.description: You rally your comrades, lock in their resolve, and turn doubt into a united stance.

options.label: IV — The Old Rules Apply
options.description: You invoke rank, rite, and precedent. The room remembers how to behave.

deck.name: Grudge Ledger
deck.trigger: Hunt the one who broke faith — find the crack, ask the alley, put it in words, or trap them with truth.

options.label: I — Find the Crack
options.description: You pick at details until the weak point shows. A name, a pattern, a mistake.

options.label: II — Ask the Right Alley
options.description: You know where rumors are born and who sells truth for cheap.

options.label: III — Put It in Words
options.description: You turn anger into a case that others can follow.

options.label: IV — Set a Trap with Truth
options.description: You bait them with what they want and watch them walk into it.

deck.name: Stone Remembers
deck.trigger: Read what the stone still holds — ancestral tales, structure, forge-work, or the rune under the dust.

options.label: I — Ancestral Tales
options.description: You recognize names, symbols, and patterns that most have forgotten.

options.label: II — See the Structure
options.description: You read weight, stress, and design. You know what holds and what will fail.

options.label: III — Hands of the Forge
options.description: You judge materials and work. You can repair, reinforce, or reshape what is there.

options.label: IV — Rune Under the Dust
options.description: You sense the hidden layer. Wards, bindings, curses, old divine traces.

deck.name: Anchor Stance
deck.trigger: Hold when pressure hits — plant your feet, become the wall, quiet footing, or never lose your center.

options.label: I — Plant Your Feet
options.description: You brace, push back, and stay where you are meant to be.

options.label: II — Become Part of the Wall
options.description: You go still and unreadable. Hard to notice, harder to move.

options.label: III — Quiet Footing
options.description: You reposition without giving them a clean angle on you.

options.label: IV — Never Off Balance
options.description: You keep control of your center. You do not get thrown, tripped, or panicked.

elorians.name: Elorians
elorians.tagline: We were not made for this world — and yet we are still here.
elorians.theme: Lingering light of a lost world — outsiders between realms, carrying memories, dreams and beauty that no longer belong here.
elorians.summary: Children of the Otherworld, Eloria. Stranded when the Four Stone Gates were sealed. Demonic marks catch like thorns in them, never fully sinking — but that resistance is its own private war.

deck.name: Mask of the Fair
deck.trigger: Courtesy as a weapon — belong in any court, bend the story, hold the room, or turn minds without force.

options.label: I — Speak Their Rules
options.description: You act like you belong and make it costly to question you.

options.label: II — Soften the Truth
options.description: You bend the story just enough to pass without breaking it.

options.label: III — Capture the Room
options.description: You choose tone and timing. People follow your rhythm instead of their doubts.

options.label: IV — Turn Them Gently
options.description: You guide their thinking without force and make them feel it was their idea.

deck.name: Twilight Read
deck.trigger: See through the mask — read motive, pulse, leverage, or desire in a layered moment.

options.label: I — Follow the Thread
options.description: You connect details into motive, pattern, and opportunity.

options.label: II — Hear the Heartbeat
options.description: You sense what they hide behind poise, fear, or pride.

options.label: III — Frame the Deal
options.description: You set terms and leverage that reveal what they truly value.

options.label: IV — Draw Them Close
options.description: You pull attention into intimacy and turn desire into access.

deck.name: Echo of Ages
deck.trigger: Old Eloria still speaks — recall forgotten history, wards, body-memory, or the geometry of lost roads.

options.label: I — Remember the Old Story
options.description: You recall fragments of history, courts, and forbidden names that still carry weight.

options.label: II — Read the Hidden Layer
options.description: You recognize wards, bindings, and the invisible rules beneath the surface.

options.label: III — Body Memory
options.description: You notice what age did to flesh and bone. Old wounds, old rituals, old methods.

options.label: IV — Trace the Way It Moved
options.description: You read routes, patterns, and the geometry of places as if the world still followed Eloria’s design.

deck.name: Unseen Grace
deck.trigger: Move as if you were never there — keep your center, vanish, blend, or take with a light touch.

options.label: I — Never Lose Your Center
options.description: You keep control through pressure. Balance, timing, and calm motion carry you through.

options.label: II — Step Between Attention
options.description: You move when eyes blink and noise rises. You pass without becoming a target.

options.label: III — Become Part of the Scene
options.description: You choose the angle and the cover that makes you simply not worth noticing.

options.label: IV — Light Touch, Clean Result
options.description: You take, plant, swap, or free something small without breaking the flow of the moment.

sentinels.name: Sentinels
sentinels.tagline: Verdicts in motion, built for gods that no longer answer.
sentinels.theme: Haunted protocols of dead gods — living verdicts with a divine core, still executing orders in a world where the issuing authority is gone.
sentinels.summary: Divinely-forged engines of judgment: ancient, deathless, built for obedience. Their radiant divine cores are hunted by demons. Some remain, some doubt, some chose to defend mortals instead of ruling them.

deck.name: Lawkeeper’s Gaze
deck.trigger: Demand an answer in public — make consequences felt, restore order, set terms, or strip excuses with rite.

options.label: I — Speak the Verdict
options.description: You make the room feel the weight of consequences.

options.label: II — Call Them to Order
options.description: You stabilize the moment and force a clear sequence: who speaks, who answers, what happens next.

options.label: III — Set the Terms
options.description: You frame the exchange as conditions and obligations, not pleading.

options.label: IV — Invoke Protocol
options.description: You use rank, rite, and procedure to strip them of excuses.

deck.name: Protocol Override
deck.trigger: Bend the moment without breaking purpose — isolate the fact, reframe the ask, feed a story, or press the fault line.

options.label: I — Trace the Facts
options.description: You isolate the key variable that makes the whole scene change.

options.label: II — Rewrite the Ask
options.description: You reframe intent so compliance becomes the “reasonable” choice.

options.label: III — Feed Them the Story
options.description: You give them a version they can accept while you keep control.

options.label: IV — Read the Fault Line
options.description: You identify what they fear, crave, or hide, then press exactly there.

deck.name: Divine Diagnostic
deck.trigger: Find the hidden failure — map the mechanism, read origin, sense corruption, or stabilize the subject.

options.label: I — Run the Schema
options.description: You map the mechanism and identify the failure point.

options.label: II — Read the Record
options.description: You recognize origin, maker, rite, and intended function.

options.label: III — Sense the Interference
options.description: You detect divine or demonic distortion and where it is anchored.

options.label: IV — Stabilize the Subject
options.description: You prevent the situation from worsening and set a clean procedure to fix it.

deck.name: Mandate Trail
deck.trigger: Keep the line and predict the break — hold the route, follow traces, lock down camp, or time the weather.

options.label: I — Hold the Route
options.description: You pick the safest, fastest path and cut off detours.

options.label: II — Follow the Signs
options.description: You read traces, habits, and direction like a report written in dust.

options.label: III — Secure the Ground
options.description: You lock down shelter, supplies, and watch so your mission can continue.

options.label: IV — Listen to the Sky
options.description: You time the move to the coming shift and avoid the worst moment to strike.

titanborn.name: Titanborn
titanborn.theme: Blood of bound giants — mortal vessels of ancient fury and purpose, wrestling with the pull toward greatness, catastrophe, and the unfinished war of their ancestors.
titanborn.summary: Awakened fury of the godless age. Where others break, Titanborn endure. Where others retreat, they advance. Their greatest struggle is often against the ancient hunger within them, the part that does not want the war to end.

deck.name: Giantblood Portent
deck.trigger: The old blood pulls at a crossroads — recall the pattern, spot the lever, test the price, or feel who will crack.

options.label: I — Remember the Pattern
options.description: You recall how this kind of story ends and what it costs.

options.label: II — See the Lever
options.description: You spot the one detail that changes everything.

options.label: III — Take the Measure
options.description: You test motives, prices, and hidden terms before you commit.

options.label: IV — Feel the Fault
options.description: You sense who is about to crack, lie, or betray.

deck.name: Break the Barrier
deck.trigger: What should not move, will — raw force, timed impact, a shadow’s angle, or endurance that does not stop.

options.label: I — Raw Force
options.description: You bend, pry, lift, and push until it gives.

options.label: II — Control the Impact
options.description: You apply strength with timing so you do not overcommit or get punished for it.

options.label: III — Through the Crowd
options.description: You reposition like a shadow despite your presence, taking the angle they never covered.

options.label: IV — Hold the Line
options.description: You keep going under pain, cold, fire, and exhaustion. You do not stop.

deck.name: Weight of the Sky
deck.trigger: Be the anchor through a long ordeal — set the pace, carry the burden, keep them alive, or read the storm.

options.label: I — Set the Pace
options.description: You pick the route and timing that preserves strength and avoids the worst.

options.label: II — Carry the Burden
options.description: You take the heavy share and make it possible for others to continue.

options.label: III — Keep Them Alive
options.description: Shelter, heat, water, food. You make the land pay its share.

options.label: IV — Read the Storm
options.description: You adjust before the weather becomes a killer.

deck.name: Harmony of the Old War
deck.trigger: Hold the group together — one plan, hard terms, painful honesty, or the human reason they fight.

options.label: I — Speak Them Back to One Plan
options.description: You impose calm purpose and give everyone something to follow.

options.label: II — Trade Peace for Terms
options.description: You find the compromise that avoids collapse.

options.label: III — Say What Hurts
options.description: You force honesty by making the cost of division obvious.

options.label: IV — Touch the Human Part
options.description: You remind them what they are protecting and why it matters.

dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
dragonborn.theme: Hidden heirs of dragons living in human skins.
dragonborn.summary: Dragonborn survive by disappearing in plain sight. At creation you must pick a Veiled Form — another Echo’s appearance only; you remain Dragonborn for all mechanics.

deck.name: Melody-Bound Memory
deck.trigger: A buried truth stirs — hear the unseen thread, name the age, read the work, or make a key detail real.

options.label: I — Hear the Chord
options.description: You sense the unseen thread and what it is tied to.

options.label: II — Name the Age
options.description: You place it in the right era, clan, and story.

options.label: III — Read the Work
options.description: You understand how it was built and where it can be bypassed.

options.label: IV — Make It Real
options.description: You recreate the key detail: a seal, a proof, a workable replica.

deck.name: The Hidden Nest
deck.trigger: Stay unseen while hunters close in — find shelter, read the pursuit, steal the weather, or turn the wild.

options.label: I — Find Shelter
options.description: You pick the safest place and the safest time to stop.

options.label: II — Read the Pursuit
options.description: You learn how close they are, and how they will approach.

options.label: III — Steal the Weather
options.description: You choose the window where nature covers your mistakes.

options.label: IV — Turn the Wild
options.description: You use beasts, noise, and instinct to draw danger away.

deck.name: Make Them Look Away
deck.trigger: Kill the wrong question — feed a story, guide the talk, move the gossip, or hide behind ritual.

options.label: I — Feed Them a Story
options.description: You give them a version that ends the curiosity.

options.label: II — Guide the Conversation
options.description: You redirect attention without raising alarms.

options.label: III — Move the Gossip
options.description: You shift the rumor through the right mouths and alleys.

options.label: IV — Hide Behind Ritual
options.description: You use protocol, titles, and social rules to shut doors politely.

deck.name: Oath of the Last
deck.trigger: Keep the line alive when fear spreads — command, bind terms, name the cost, or speak to the real need.

options.label: I — Speak as Command
options.description: You make people stand together long enough to act.

options.label: II — Bind It in Terms
options.description: You turn intent into obligation and clear commitments.

options.label: III — Remind Them of Cost
options.description: You make the consequences feel real and immediate.

options.label: IV — Name the Real Need
options.description: You identify what breaks them and offer the one thing that holds.

unbound.name: Unbound
unbound.tagline: The Wyld does not name us. It uses us.
unbound.theme: Living answers without a stable self. You survive by adapting, masking, and turning pressure into motion.
unbound.summary: The world’s reaction when something is forced to become what it was never meant to be. Beasts, Witches, and Banes — not one people, one response. Not gentle, not evil — corrective, instinctive, made to oppose what does not belong.

coreTraits.name: The Response Takes Over
coreTraits.effect: When an Unbound is pushed too far, the response may take over. The Beast becomes the shape that hunts. The Witch becomes the curse that speaks through flesh. The Bane becomes the weapon that can no longer stop hunting. Powerful, useful, and never fully theirs.

trait.name: Beast
trait.effect: The body's response. Predator Crown occupies the Head Slot. Choose a Predator Shape and one Predator Stone path (Might, Wits, or Intellect).

trait.name: Root Staff
trait.effect: Rootbinding is Ranged Attack + Slow. Covenant Overdrive uses Active Buff: Special Increase + Slow. Witch Staff occupies both hands.
trait.flavor: Buried wood, grave roots, old circles.

trait.name: Ruin Staff
trait.effect: Ruinous Word is Ranged Attack + Hex. Covenant Overdrive uses Active Buff: Special Increase + Hex. Witch Staff occupies both hands.

trait.name: Blight Staff
trait.effect: Blightcall is Ranged Attack + Corrode. Covenant Overdrive uses Active Buff: Special Increase + Corrode. Witch Staff occupies both hands.

trait.name: Alchemist Coat
trait.effect: Medium Armor. Red Potion is Active Buff: Damage. Black Potion is Active Buff: Critical. Alchemist Stone supports Vitality Ability: Extend Active Buff.

trait.name: Green Warden Mantle
trait.effect: Medium Armor. Thorns is Active Buff: Thorns. Warden's Guard is Reaction: Ally Armor. Green Warden Stone supports Resolve Ability: Special Reduction.

trait.name: Hunter's Scourge
trait.effect: Two-handed chain-whip. Exorcism Lash is Melee Attack + Exorcism. Snap Chain is Artifact Reaction: Damage + Pull. Whirling Scourge is Melee AoE Attack + Exorcism.

deck.name: Hunger Shapes the Path
deck.trigger: Take what the world withholds — follow the trace, read the land, find the pattern, or make do and move.

options.label: I — Follow the Trace
options.description: You find the freshest sign and keep it in your hands.

options.label: II — Read the Land
options.description: You choose the route that the world least wants you to take.

options.label: III — Find the Pattern
options.description: You notice the repeating detail that reveals where the truth is hiding.

options.label: IV — Make Do and Move
options.description: You improvise shelter, leverage, or a way through with what is available.

deck.name: Wear the World
deck.trigger: Vanish before the scene swallows you — become still, move unseen, slip the gap, or take what you need.

options.label: I — Become Still
options.description: You pick the perfect place to be forgotten.

options.label: II — Move Unseen
options.description: You cross attention without giving it a handle.

options.label: III — Slip the Gap
options.description: You pass where bodies should not pass.

options.label: IV — Take What You Need
options.description: You steal seconds, objects, or small truths without starting a fight.

deck.name: The Room Is Territory
deck.trigger: Someone yields first — show teeth, set the pace, know the undercurrent, or claim the right.

options.label: I — Show Teeth
options.description: You make consequences feel close and real.

options.label: II — Set the Pace
options.description: You force order onto chaos so people follow a sequence you control.

options.label: III — Know the Undercurrent
options.description: You spot who truly runs this space and what they fear losing.

options.label: IV — Claim the Right
options.description: You use rule, rank, and ritual to corner them into behaving.

deck.name: Speak Like a Mask
deck.trigger: Steer perception to survive the next minute — sell the role, give a story, turn them gently, or touch the real fear.

options.label: I — Make It Believable
options.description: You sell a role so well that doubt feels rude.

options.label: II — Give Them a Story
options.description: You provide the version they can accept while you keep the truth.

options.label: III — Turn Them Gently
options.description: You guide them to the choice that keeps you alive.

options.label: IV — Touch the Real Fear
options.description: You find what they actually feel, then speak to that instead of their words.
